data.failure.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Expected acceptance failure
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: AUTOMATION_EXPECTED_FAILURE
data.pve-sync.yml:
---
- name: PVE 虚拟机与主机管理同步
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: 核对并同步 PVE 虚拟机台账
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: "{{ ['python3', playbook_dir + '/sync_pve_hosts.py', '--config', '/run/pve-sync/config.json'] + ([] if ansible_check_mode else ['--apply']) }}"
      check_mode: false
      register: sync_result
      changed_when: "not ansible_check_mode and 'DONE ' in sync_result.stdout"
    - name: 显示同步结果
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: sync_result.stdout_lines
data.stop.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Wait before writing isolated marker
      ansible.builtin.shell: sleep 20; echo STOP_FAILED > /tmp/automation-stop-marker
      changed_when: false
data.success.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Validate isolated execution
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: 2 + 2 == 4
    - name: Report acceptance
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: AUTOMATION_REAL_EXECUTION_OK

command: umask 0007; mkdir -p /state/gateway /state/engine /state/config /state/runbooks; chmod 0770 /state/*; for f in /runbooks/*.yml /runbooks/*.py; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; n=${f##*/}; [ -e "/state/runbooks/$n" ] || cp "$f" "/state/runbooks/$n"; done; cd /state/runbooks; [ -d .git ] || git init -b main; git add -- '*.yml' '*.py'; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git -c user.name=OpsCenter -c user.email=automation@localhost commit -m 'Add PVE inventory sync runbook'; fi; chmod -R g+rwX /state/runbooks
initContainers.name: prepare-data
